modules.pitch-manipulation.save_selected: Save selected audio downloads WAV for a single version or ZIP for multiple versions. A save dialog lets you choose a location when supported; other browsers use their download settings.

modules.pitch-manipulation.save_the_curr: Save the current F0 and parameter draft before switching files?
modules.pitch-manipulation.play_original: Play original in current view plays the visible original interval directly; Play synthesized audio plays the full output. Selection playback uses the last mouse-selected original or synthesized interval, independently of those buttons. Synthesize full audio explicitly processes the whole audio using the complete edited F0 curve. After tempo changes, synthesized waveforms show actual output duration.
modules.pitch-manipulation.defaults_f0_r: Defaults: F0 range 50–350 Hz, tempo 1.0, pitch multiplier 1.0. Reference lines may be horizontal Hz or vertical seconds; vertical positions use original-audio time. Both types coexist and are saved with editing drafts. Tempo and pitch accept multiple comma- or space-separated values. Choose either pitch multiplier or Hz shift; two tempos and three pitches generate six versions per original. Single-file pitch adjustment applies to the current edited F0; turning-point batch generation uses independent parameters. Praat extraction retains its defaults; Manipulation uses 0.01 s and 75–600 Hz. Tempo and folder pitch use the original 0.01 transformation threshold. Single-file F0 pitch uses the entered multiplier or shift.
modules.pitch-manipulation.ascending_des: Ascending/descending modes sort lists first; all combinations follow input order; constant uses the first value. Turning points must lie between endpoints. Shift-mode values are Hz increments.
modules.pitch-manipulation.after_drawing: After drawing, importing F0, or successful batch synthesis, the history plot shows F0 re-extracted from actual output audio, aligned to zero onset. Play this version loads and plays the full audio. Completing multiple versions or folder processing opens batch saving for all originals in this run. After cancellation, Save latest batch reopens it. Add sequence numbers is unchecked by default; enabling it adds 1_, 2_, etc. in selection order without changing historical names. Clicking a task version switches to its original and output; choose save or discard first if current edits are unsaved. Generated results remain in task history. Save synthesized audio and Batch save ask for an output folder. The right panel then shows the full last-saved folder and actual file names, without adding history records. Same-name files are preserved.
modules.pitch-manipulation.method_src_pr: Method: SRC-PRAAT. Nonzero Hz batch shifts fix the legacy error of passing invalid unit Hz to Praat by using Hertz; other computation order is retained.
